verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs describe it as "an open source platform" (pulumi-docs-28), and the core engine's source is published in the public pulumi/pulumi GitHub repository (pulumi-gh-1, pulumi-gh-3). A community remark that the license was a "stumbling block" is vague and does not concretely contradict this. missing for 10: the specific license name (e.g., the actual OSI license text), independent corroboration of the licensing terms, and clarity on whether the Pulumi Cloud/self-hosted backend source is also open (evidence suggests self-hosting is Enterprise-only).
